subject: Uptime bridge options, hours-of-operation escalation & pricing
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: uptime tiers + 24/7 escalation bands for pilot

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme is evaluating Redwood for a pilot across two product lines. We need a clear picture of how your SLA packaging maps to hours-of-operation and escalation coverage. Quick bullets of what we need: 

- Uptime commitment tiers (99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99) and how credits scale by % downtime
- Response windows for P1/P2/P3 across business hours and nights/weekends
- Options for a 24/7 on-call escalation path (named on-call vs. shared rotation) and pricing impact
- Any volume-based discounts tied to committed throughput (monthly token/embedding units) and term length
- A suggested mutual action plan so procurement can move quickly if legal is ok

We are aiming to start a 3-month pilot in Sep with an option to expand to an annual committed plan. Can you share a short price band and an example MAP? Also copy our procurement lead (ProcureOps) so they’re in the thread.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Ops, Acme Cloud

---

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: uptime tiers + 24/7 escalation bands for pilot

Sanjay — great to hear and thanks for the clarity. Attaching a compact pricing summary and MAP draft (see attachments). High-level reply below so you can share with procurement: 

- Uptime tiers: 99.9% (Standard), 99.95% (Enhanced), 99.99% (Premium). Credit schedule included on pg2 of the PDF.
- Response windows (SLO targets):
  * P1 (service down / severe impact): 30 min response during business hours; 60 min nights/weekends for Standard. Enhanced: 15 min / 30 min; Premium: 5 min / 15 min.
  * P2 (degraded experience): 2 hours business; 4 hours nights/weekends (Standard). Enhanced/Premium reduce by ~50%.
  * P3 (low impact): next-business-day triage.
- 24/7 escalation options: 
  * Option A — Shared pooled escalation (no named individual): +10% list price. 24/7 triage team routes to engineering weekday coverage 9–5 PT, with on-call for P1 outside those hours.
  * Option B — Dedicated named on-call (phone/SMS escalation & guaranteed pager handoffs): +35% list price; includes direct rotation and faster on-call escalations.
- Volume/term discounts: 6–12% for 12-month commits depending on throughput; example tiers in MAP-draft-Acme.xlsx.

I’ll propose the MAP milestones in the attachment (pilot kickoff, instrumenting SLIs, 30-day review, go/no-go, expansion).

Attachments: redwood-sla-pricing-v1.pdf, MAP-draft-Acme.xlsx

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, ProcureOps <procure@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: uptime tiers + 24/7 escalation bands for pilot

Sanjay — adding more granularity on pricing + a practical suggestion to keep the pilot simple. Proposed banding below (annualized list price equivalent shown):

- Standard (99.9): base list — $12,000/mo equivalent. Credits as per PDF table (sliding scale, capped).
- Enhanced (99.95): base list — $18,000/mo equivalent (+50% list). Includes faster triage and quarterly SLA review.
- Premium (99.99): base list — $29,000/mo equivalent (+140% list). Includes extended runbook integration and quarterly DR drills.

Escalation add-ons (applied to base):
- Shared 24/7 triage: +10% (recommended for pilots that want continuous monitoring without named on-call)
- Dedicated on-call rotation (named): +35% (required for enterprise XLA/risky workloads)

Discount guidance for Acme:
- 3-month pilot: standard pricing with no term discount.
- 12-month commit: eligible for 8–12% off base depending on committed throughput.

Procurement note: we can provide a single-sheet SOW and a DocuSign-ready SOW once we align on tier and escalation option. Vanessa — can you confirm any executive discount guardrails we should apply?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: Melanie Torres <melanie@finops-acme.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@brightcart.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: uptime tiers + 24/7 escalation bands for pilot

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement has two follow-ups before we can pull legal in: 

1) Can you confirm the credit payout mechanism (invoice credit vs. pro-rata refund) and timing? Our treasury prefers invoice credit applied to the following month.
2) For dedicated on-call, provide a short blameless escalation flow and the expected response SLAs for handoffs. We need to understand incident ownership boundaries.
3) SOC2 evidence: we’ll ask for a SOC2 Type II summary and the controls mapping for uptime/incident response. Please attach any checklist.

If you can answer these before EOD tomorrow, procurement can draft a conditional PO that would convert to an annual commit pending legal and SOC attestation.

—Melanie
Melanie Torres
Procurement Manager, Acme Cloud

---

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Melanie Torres <melanie@finops-acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, ProcureOps <procure@brightcart.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: uptime tiers + 24/7 escalation bands for pilot

Melanie — answering inline and attaching a SOC2 checklist per your ask.

1) Credit mechanism: invoice credit applied to next invoice is our standard approach; we can do pro-rata refunds for enterprise customers on request but that requires finance approval in SOW. We will note invoice credit as the default for the MAP/PO language.

2) Dedicated on-call flow (summary):
   - P1 triggers notification to named on-call via pager/SMS (within 5 minutes).
   - On-call performs initial mitigation and opens an incident in our tracking board; if unresolved after 30 minutes, primary engineering lead is paged.
   - Handoff occurs via a structured handover (incident runbook + bridge notes). Ownership remains with Redwood until Acme accepts mitigation or we escalate to joint postmortem.
   - We include quarterly joint DR tabletop drills for Premium customers to validate handoffs.

3) SOC2: attaching SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (summary of where controls live and the next steps to provide the Type II report under NDA).

Commercial concession: for a 12-month commit converting from the pilot within 45 days of go/no-go, Redwood can offer an additional 10% off the 12-month sticker (stacked with the standard 8–12% volume discount) for dedicated on-call customers. This concession requires signature by vendor management and is contingent on a minimum MRR threshold (details in the MAP).

Next steps: 
- Mateo to send DocuSign-ready SOW (we’ll use the MAP milestones).
- Procurement to share conditional PO.
- Legal/Trust to exchange NDA/SOC2 access after conditional PO.

I’ll attach the SOW template and send a DocuSign link once you confirm the escalation option.

Best,
Mateo
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf, redwood-sla-pricing-v1.pdf, MAP-draft-Acme.xlsx
